name: Montgomery County, Maryland (United States)
description: Banner of the county arms: quartered blue and red with a castellated bar across the centre, a yellow fleur-de-lis in the first and fourth quarters and a yellow ring in the second and third.
history: Montgomery County is the most populous county in Maryland. The flag, adopted on 5 October 1976 by Bill 38-76, is a banner of the shield of the county arms designed and approved by the College of Arms in London.

features.role: fleurs-de-lis in the first and fourth quarters
rings in the second and third quarters
